The independent all-sign checker enumerates 152928 signed edge potentials across 30 mixed-arm profiles and matches every norm, contact count, and rank.

value.rationale: Partially subdivided stars are a natural minimal heterogeneous tree class with the same abstract crosspolytope Banach geometry as other trees but different inherited Euclidean geometry. The full-height extremizer principle and exact sign-discrepancy/contact-rank formulas classify an infinite two-parameter family. At three short arms the parity of long-arm count changes the affine incenter dimension by two and changes tangent-facet multiplicities, making the invariant sensitive to metric realization rather than to combinatorial type.
